validity.shape_gate: passed (both geometries: exact invariants + C1 / C2)
validity.legs: 4 / 4 (A1 B1 B2 A2), 30 measured samples each, 60 per condition

claim_boundary: This experiment measures the CURRENT RABIT implementation on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct's geometry (28 layers, 28 Q / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, GQA ratio 7).

RABIT serves this geometry through existing exact FALLBACK paths for decode attention, token append and V2 quantization; the Llama-optimized fast paths are not used, so no claim is made that the optimized kernels generalized.

Allowed interpretation: the frozen RABIT representation and physical serving system operate on a different GQA geometry, while the current implementation uses untuned fallback kernels for that geometry.
Within-Qwen BF16 vs RABIT is a valid matched single-request system comparison (same session, H100 80GB, snapshot, engine settings, prompt, order).
Cross-model Llama-vs-Qwen absolute latency is descriptive only (different model and session).
No throughput claim; no confidence intervals or significance tests; the 60 timings per condition are not independent replicates.
Quality has NOT been run for Exp14.
